title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: The student's final answer for U_AB must be 40 V.

title: Correct field magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for E must be 2000 V/m.

title: Work-energy relationship
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the change in potential energy to the work done by the electric field (W_AB = -ΔPE).

title: Potential difference definition
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula U_AB = W_AB / q to find the potential difference.

title: Correct parallel distance
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the component of the displacement parallel to the field (d = AB * cos 60° = 0.02 m).

title: Field from potential gradient
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the uniform field relationship E = U_AB / d.

title: Sign error with negative charge
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly handles the sign of the charge when calculating U_AB or the work.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should correctly convert all distances to meters and maintain consistent SI units throughout.
